bio: Francesca Maria Orlando was baptized on 22 October 1794 at San Mango D'Aquino in Calabria, the daughter of Agostino Orlando and Maria Mollame, who had married on 6 May 1782. On 16 March 1819 she married Francesco Moraca. She is John's 4th-great-grandmother.
